title: checkout-api error ratio above objective
body: Alert checkout-api-error-ratio fired. Observed 5xx ratio 0.184 over a 5 minute window against an objective of 0.005. Affected route: POST /v2/checkout/submit. Alert remained firing until 09:58:10Z.

title: checkout-api latency objective burn
body: Alert checkout-api-latency fired. p99 latency for POST /v2/checkout/submit rose from 240ms to 10400ms. The 10400ms value sits at the configured client timeout, which is a ceiling rather than a measured completion time.

title: checkout-api release 2026.5.14-a
body: Release 2026.5.14-a deployed to production at 09:09:52Z, two minutes and eleven seconds before alert-4471 fired. Changes: copy edits to three checkout confirmation email templates, and a dependency bump of the CSV export library used by the nightly reconciliation job. No code path in this release is reachable from POST /v2/checkout/submit.

title: checkout-api rollback to 2026.5.13-c
body: Rollback of checkout-api to 2026.5.13-c completed at 10:04:18Z. The 5xx ratio had already returned to 0.004 at 09:58:10Z, six minutes before this rollback completed.

title: payments connector TLS handshake failures begin
body: checkout-api payments-connector: repeated outbound TLS handshake failures to payments-gateway.internal:8443. Error: certificate verify failed: certificate has expired. First occurrence 09:11:47Z, sustained at 40-60 events per second.

title: checkout submit returns 502
body: checkout-api: POST /v2/checkout/submit returning 502 upstream_unavailable after payments-connector exhausted 3 retries. Correlated with payments-connector TLS failures.

title: payments connector recovers
body: checkout-api payments-connector: outbound TLS handshakes to payments-gateway.internal:8443 succeeding again. Error rate returned to baseline at 09:57:55Z.

title: sampled failing checkout trace
body: Trace 5f21c0: POST /v2/checkout/submit total 10402ms. Span checkout.validate 12ms ok. Span payments.authorize 10388ms error, terminated by client timeout, no upstream response recorded. No span entered the email template or CSV export code paths.

title: responder attributes incident to the release
body: Responder A: 'We shipped 2026.5.14-a two minutes before this started. That is almost certainly the cause, let us roll it back.'

title: responder disputes the release attribution
body: Responder B: 'The release only touched email templates and the CSV export dependency. Nothing in it is on the submit path. The connector logs show expired-certificate TLS failures starting at 09:11:47Z, which is before the alert but after the deploy. I think we are looking at the payments gateway certificate.'

title: gateway team reports certificate rotation
body: Responder C from the payments-gateway team: 'Our leaf certificate for payments-gateway.internal expired at 09:11:40Z. We rotated it and it took effect at 09:57:50Z. We have no record of who owns the renewal automation for that host.'

title: INC-7742 opened
body: INC-7742 opened at 09:15:00Z, severity 1, title 'Checkout submit failing for all customers'. Impact field left empty. No customer-impact estimate was recorded at any point during the incident.

title: INC-7742 resolution note
body: INC-7742 marked resolved. Resolution note reads only 'rolled back and recovered'. The note does not mention the certificate rotation reported in the incident channel.
